description.zh: 示例索引：只收录 dsh-pet-restnow 一个插件，用于提交给商城维护方合并。插件收录使用 format-1 索引，与公开的工作台目录（schemaVersion 2 / workbenches）不是同一份文件。
description.en: Example format-1 plugin index containing only dsh-pet-restnow, for merging into the real market index. Not the schemaVersion-2 workbench catalog.

description.zh: 让桌宠扩展番茄钟计时功能，能召唤番茄钟一起提醒你休息，帮你专注：如休息弹窗（含全屏）出现时桌宠走到卡片正上方陪着并出现相应的表情，桌宠右键菜单扩展出番茄钟相关功能等。建议搭配歇会儿RestNow使用，如需下载 https://xiehuier.cn
description.en: Extends your desktop pet with a Pomodoro timer and summons the timer to remind you to rest and stay focused: when a break popup (including fullscreen) appears, the pet walks to the top of the card to keep you company and shows the matching expression; the pet's right-click menu gains Pomodoro-related actions. Best paired with RestNow (https://xiehuier.cn); download it there if needed.
